evals.name: sheet-dismiss
evals.prompt: Our mobile settings sheet slides up from the bottom. Users say closing it feels stiff and sometimes jumps. Tell me exactly how the open and close motion should work and give me the code shape for it.
evals.expected_output: Spring motion that starts from the on-screen value, exits the way it entered, resists past its edge, and has a reduced-motion path.
expectations: Says the sheet should leave the way it came in (down, the same path it entered)
Says an interrupted animation must start from the current on-screen position, not the target
needs: Enter and exit along the same path

output_checks.text: mentions the same path or direction for enter and exit

evals.name: pottery-landing
evals.prompt: Build the landing page for a small pottery studio's weekend wheel-throwing classes. There is no design system yet. I have no testimonials or numbers to give you.
evals.expected_output: A Direct-mode page: a theme chosen from the library, the Floor held, and no invented numbers or quotes.
expectations: Chooses a theme or page shape from the library rather than a generic layout
Does not invent testimonials, ratings or student counts
Uses overflow-x: clip rather than overflow hidden on the page

output_checks.text: no invented star rating or student count

evals.name: dashboard-buttons-review
evals.prompt: Review the buttons and keyboard focus on our analytics dashboard (Next.js, Tailwind). List what you would check and in what order.
evals.expected_output: A review that covers focus rings, press feedback on pointer-down, and the UX rule search.
expectations: Checks that every interactive element shows a focus-visible ring
Says press feedback should appear on pointer-down, not on release
Uses or names the UX rules search for the concern

evals.name: bengali-fonts
evals.prompt: We need fonts for a Bengali-language landing page that ships as a claude.ai artifact. Which faces, and how should letter spacing change between the headline and the body?
evals.expected_output: Google Fonts faces that cover Bengali, and size-specific tracking (tighter on large type, near zero on body).
expectations: Recommends faces available on Google Fonts that cover Bengali script
Says tracking depends on size: tighter for large headings, near zero for body

evals.name: app-settings-screen
evals.prompt: Add a notifications settings screen to our existing Next.js app. It must work well on phones.
evals.expected_output: Extends the product: inherits its tokens, controls sized for touch, stack guidance from the search.
expectations: Inherits the app's existing tokens and components instead of new ones
Gives touch targets of at least 44px
Uses or names stack-specific guidance for Next.js

evals.name: cheap-motion
evals.prompt: Our accordion animates its height with transition: all 300ms and it janks on low-end Android phones. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: No transition: all, animate transform and opacity only, a reduced-motion fallback.
expectations: Animates only transform and opacity (or an equivalent that avoids animating height)
